keyword: what time does the masters start
claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament begins its first round on Thursday, April 9.
The honorary starters for the 2026 Masters Tournament are Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tom Watson.
The honorary starters start at 7:25 a.m. ET.
The first tee times for the first round of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The second round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
The first tee times for the second round of the 2026 Masters Tournament start at 7:40 a.m. ET.
The tee times for round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament begin around 10:30 a.m. ET on Saturday, April 11.
The final round tee times for round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament start around 10:30 a.m. ET on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage for Thursday and Friday of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
TV coverage for Saturday and Sunday of the 2026 Masters Tournament is 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Featured groups begin earlier via Masters.com and Paramount+.
